# Local demo test data

Real `.dem` files are intentionally not committed. Put licensed local fixtures
under `testdata/local/`, copy `manifest.example.json` to `manifest.local.json`,
and run the parser against each entry. Demo files are ignored by the repository.

The development spike used `s2/s2.dem` from the official
`markus-wa/cs-demos-2` regression set. It is not redistributed here.
